title: Cholinesterase assay by an efficient fixed time endpoint method
author: Benabent, Vilanova, et al.
materials: An automated Work Station (Beckman Biomek 2000) was employed, but the process can also be performed manually. By reducing all the volumes proportionally to ¼, for a final volume of 205 μL, the full process can be performed directly in a thermostat 96-well microplate.
The data recorded by the microplate reader were processed and graphic adjustments were made with the Sigma Plot software (Systat Software Inc, Chicago, USA) for Windows.

steps.title: Prepare brain tissue homogenate
steps.instruction: Obtain hen brains immediately after sacrifice, store at 0–5 °C, keep in 50 mM Tris‑HCl pH 8.0 buffer containing 1 mM EDTA (use within 1 h). Homogenise 200 mg fresh tissue per mL of this buffer with a Polytron (Kinematica GmbH, PTA 10S head) at 70 % power, three bursts of 3 s each.

steps.title: Fractionate homogenate by centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the homogenate at 1 000 × g for 10 min at 4 °C; collect the pellet (fibres and nuclei). Transfer the supernatant and centrifuge it at 100 000 × g for 60 min to obtain mitochondrial/microsomal fractions.

steps.title: Resuspend pellet in Tris‑Triton buffer
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in Tris‑Triton buffer composed of 50 mM Tris‑HCl pH 8.0, 1 mM EDTA and 1 % (v/v) Triton X‑100.

steps.title: Store and thaw enzyme fractions
steps.instruction: Aliquot the supernatant (soluble fraction) and the resuspended pellet (membrane fraction) and store them in liquid nitrogen. Thaw the required aliquots at room temperature before use.

steps.title: Dilute enzyme preparations
steps.instruction: Dilute each enzyme preparation with phosphate buffer to the desired concentration, expressing the dilution as μL preparation per mL of final solution.

steps.title: Add buffer or test reagents
steps.instruction: In each 1 mL microtube add 20 μL of phosphate buffer (for blanks) or 20 μL of the inhibitor/other reagent to be tested.

steps.title: Add enzyme and preincubate
steps.instruction: Add 200 μL of the diluted membrane or soluble enzyme preparation (or phosphate buffer for blanks) to each tube. Incubate at 37 °C for the desired pre‑incubation time (shorten if no inhibitors are present).

steps.title: Add acetylthiocholine substrate
steps.instruction: Add 200 μL of acetylthiocholine solution in water, giving a final substrate concentration between 1 mM and 14.3 mM in a total reaction volume of 420 μL.

steps.title: Run enzymatic reaction
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture at 37 °C for exactly 10 min.

steps.title: Stop reaction with SDS/DTNB
steps.instruction: Add 200 μL of 2 % SDS containing 6 mM DTNB to each tube to terminate the reaction.

steps.title: Add post‑stop buffer
steps.instruction: Add 200 μL of phosphate buffer (or diluted enzyme preparation for blanks). The final assay volume is 820 μL. Mix well and let stand for at least 5 min.

steps.title: Transfer and read absorbance
steps.instruction: Transfer 300 μL from each tube to a 96‑well microplate and measure absorbance at 410 nm.

steps.title: Optional quarter‑volume format
steps.instruction: Scale all volumes to one‑quarter (final volume 205 μL) and perform the entire assay directly in a thermostat‑controlled 96‑well plate; this can be done manually or with a Beckman Biomek 2000 workstation.
